Thus $-4\hat{i} - 7\hat{j} - 13\hat{k}$. Magnitude = $\sqrt{16 + 49 + 169} = \sqrt{234}$. question: What is the vector triple product $A \times (B \times C)$ equivalent to?
explanation: According to the standard vector identity, $A \times (B \times C) = (A \cdot C)B - (A \cdot B)C$ (often remembered as the 'BAC minus CAB' rule).
